sentences: Both assignments run together, so a[0] gets 7 and a[1] gets the old 4.
The two lines swap the values in one go, giving me 7 then 4.
Since they happen at the same time, the numbers just exchange places.
a[0] takes the 7 from a[1] and a[1] takes the 4 from a[0] together.
Writing a[0]=a[1] and a[1]=a[0] as one step swaps both values.
